fields.statement: In ship-change, ci-triage (`rhiza ship check --test-failures`) has no on.fail. So a red PR head whose CI logs name no failing test (an infra or unparsable failure, e.g. GitHub refusing every job for billing, after `rhiza ship check` has used its rerun budget) ends the run. The change set's intent says such a failure should send the run back to wait on CI instead. Sending it straight to wait-pr would loop at once, because the head is already settled red, until max_visits ends the run. What should ci-triage do on an infra-only failure?
